errors.evidence: The x-axis shows the years 2007, 2010, 2013, and 2016. The intervals between these points are 3 years, not one year.
The blue line for "говеда" (cattle) starts at approximately 19,000 in 2007, not 18,000.
The value for "говеда" (cattle) in 2010 is approximately 16,500, not 15,000.
The value for "говеда" (cattle) in 2016 is approximately 14,100, not 15,000.
The line for "крави" (cows) is orange, not red.
The markers for the "крави" (cows) line are round, not triangular. In fact, all series use round markers.
The value for "крави" (cows) in 2016 is approximately 7,500, not 8,000.
The markers for the "кози" (goats) line are round, not square.

errors.text_span: Тя се поддържа на ниво 2 000 през 2007, 2010 и 2013 г. и достига 3 000 през 2016 г.
errors.evidence: The entire description of the "кози" (goats) line is incorrect. The values start at around 1,000 in 2007 and decrease to almost 0 by 2016. They are never close to 2,000 or 3,000.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от 8 000 през 2007 г., спада до 7 000 през 2010 г., намалява до 6 000 през 2013 г. и после достига 7 000 през 2016 г.
errors.evidence: The entire description of the "овце" (sheep) line is incorrect. The value in 2007 is ~15,800 (not 8,000), it increases to ~17,500 in 2010 (not decreases to 7,000), then drops to ~7,500 in 2013 (not 6,000), and rises slightly to ~8,300 in 2016 (not 7,000).
